conclusion: Same renderer grows 124–126 MiB between pre-navigation and initialized main WASM before invoking its Rust start; no worker exists then. App/editor plus worker subsequently add 109–114 MiB before cold readiness. Main linear capacity before Rust start is 19.94 MiB. Pre-start growth includes navigation, module loading/compilation/instantiation, CSS and preload processing; it is not isolated compiler allocation. Investigate runtime/module load separately from editor document allocations. No production memory reduction is established.
